title: SelectConfig
description: Serializable configuration for the RibbonUI select atom.

id.description: Stable select instance identifier; also the native select DOM id.

value.description: Controlled selected option value owned by the host; empty when omitted.
Option form value submitted when selected.

options.description: Allowlisted option list rendered as native option elements.

placeholder.description: Optional placeholder rendered as a disabled first option with an empty value.

name.description: Form field name for native form submission.

size.description: Explicit field density and target size.

disabled.description: Whether native activation and focus participation are disabled.

required.description: Whether the field must have a value for native form submission.
